columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: Invoice number, kept as text (identifiers are text; Session D rule). A leading C marks a cancellation invoice; see is_cancellation.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from the committed contract; fresh profile agrees (VARCHAR, required true).

columns.name: is_cancellation
columns.description: True when invoice_id carries the C cancellation prefix. Decision: cancellations are retained and flagged, not dropped, so conservation arithmetic against bronze stays auditable; exclusion is a consumer decision made at the mapping contract, not silently here.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from the committed contract; fresh profile agrees (BOOLEAN, required true).

columns.name: stock_code
columns.description: Product code as landed, kept as text; alphanumeric suffixes and non-product adjustment codes (for example POST, M) occur.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from the committed contract; fresh profile agrees (VARCHAR, required true).

columns.name: product_description
columns.description: Product description, whitespace-trimmed. Null rate 0.005041 at profile v0001; nulls retained rather than imputed.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from the committed contract; fresh profile agrees (VARCHAR, required false).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Units on the line, cast DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER (integral min, max, and samples at v0001). Negative on cancellation lines and on zero-price stock-adjustment lines; consumers must not read every negative quantity as a cancellation.
columns.rationale: Fresh profile: INTEGER, null_rate 0.0, min -1395; the warehouse holds negative-quantity lines outside cancellations, all at unit_price 0.

columns.name: invoiced_at
columns.description: Invoice timestamp. Decision: strict cast from the VARCHAR landing ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"); an unparseable value fails the build loudly rather than becoming a silent null. On within-invoice clock-drift duplicates the earliest scan tick wins (min).
columns.rationale: Unchanged from the committed contract; fresh profile agrees (TIMESTAMP, required true).

columns.name: unit_price
columns.description: Unit price in sterling, cast from DECIMAL(38,9). Observed range 0.00 to 1998.49 at v0001. Decision: zero-price lines (freebies and adjustments) are retained; negative prices are contract-invalid.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from the committed contract; fresh profile agrees (DECIMAL(10,2), required true).

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: Customer identifier, cast DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER (integral min, max, and samples, 12346 to 18287 at v0001). Decision: the 0.29778 bronze null rate is retained as null (guest or unregistered checkouts), not dropped and not imputed.
columns.rationale: Unchanged from the committed contract; fresh profile agrees (INTEGER, required false).

columns.name: country
columns.description: Customer country as landed (24 distinct at v0001).
columns.rationale: Unchanged from the committed contract; fresh profile agrees (VARCHAR, required true).

quality_rules.rationale: The committed sample yields tens of thousands of surviving lines; an empty table is a broken build.
The committed four-column grain is unique by measurement after capture-artifact exclusion; duplicate_row_rate 0.0 at the fresh profile.
Profiled min 0.0; the committed contract already declares negative prices invalid.

changes.after: Units on the line, cast DECIMAL(38,9) to INTEGER (integral min, max, and samples at v0001). Negative on cancellation lines and on zero-price stock-adjustment lines; consumers must not read every negative quantity as a cancellation.
changes.rationale: Measured against the warehouse: negative-quantity rows exist outside cancellation lines, every one at unit_price 0 (stock-adjustment lines with zero revenue impact), so the committed sentence is inaccurate as written.

decisions.rationale: Negative quantities on non-cancellation lines are real and carry unit_price 0; the description now states both negative cases instead of claiming cancellations only.

purpose: The cleaned, typed, one-row-per-invoice-line view of the Online Retail II sample: the first contracted silver table and the sole silver input to the gold unified event star.
usage: Read silver.silver_invoice_lines for line-level retail sales analysis. Cancellation lines are retained and flagged (is_cancellation); consumers aggregating revenue must filter or net them deliberately. Zero-price lines are retained, including negative-quantity stock-adjustment lines.
limitations: Exact duplicate bronze rows are treated as capture artifacts and excluded; rows identical except invoicedate collapse to the earliest timestamp; customer_id is null on guest checkouts and retained as null.
